parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name, IMO number or MMSI. Names match by prefix (and by substring from 3 characters, see `match`); 1–9 digits (optionally `IMO…`) match IMO numbers and MMSIs starting with them. Exact matches rank first, then prefix, then substring matches.

parameters.name: match
parameters.description: Name matching: `prefix` (indexed only), `contains` (adds substring matches, scans the table), `auto` (adds substring matches only when the prefix matches do not fill one page). Numeric queries never match substrings.
